conf.description: FireEye FX file-security CEF notification feed: header split + label-indirected cs1/cs4 decode (sname/link resolved via their Label pairs, not assumed by position) per recommendations.direct.cribl, derive file.name from filePath when fname absent, keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / fx-alert / syslog-cef. Single-line CEF alternative to the JSON feed (mutually exclusive Format selection on the notification channel). No os-changes trace and only one fileHash (MD5) on this transport. cs1(sname)/cs4(link) slot assignment can drift across trains, so the pipeline reads each slot's *Label companion dynamically instead of assuming position, per recommendations.direct.cribl. fname is used when present; otherwise file.name is derived from the final segment of filePath (UNC-style share path). rt (standard CEF receipt-time extension) is used for _time - not its own fields[] row, added by analogy to the sibling nx-alert CEF pipeline since every event needs a timestamp. Keeps _raw.

functions.description: split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since the pattern isn't anchored)

tokenize the extension blob (space-lookahead split, tolerant of embedded spaces), map flat file/action/id/host keys, resolve cs1/cs4 via their Label pairs with a positional fallback, receipt-time/severity/action handling, dataset/category tags, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
